description: Project-level spending policy requires an account-owner action, not a retry loop.

diagnosis.title: Usage or spending limit reached
diagnosis.summary: This is a quota, credit, or spending constraint. Waiting briefly will not repair it.
next_steps: Check credits, usage, and project or organization limits with the account owner.
Resolve the returned limit before making another request, even if Retry-After is present.
Preserve the request ID, UTC time, and affected project for escalation.

stop_reason: No automatic retry: investigate or correct the issue first.
logging_policy: No API credentials, input prompts, raw response bodies, or generated content are saved.
